# Demo Playwright Rust for Google Maps

> A Rust + `playwright-rs` test-pattern demo for Google Maps: real assertions, never executed against the live site. Read the caution in README.md first.

## Docs

- [README](README.md): The Terms-of-Service caution, what this demo tests, install notes.
- [Spec](spec/index.md): The exact three test scenarios, selectors, and assertions, as the single source of truth.
- [Agent instructions](AGENTS.md): The non-negotiable never-execute-against-live-google.com rule.
- [Citation](CITATION.cff): How to cite this software.

## Source

- [demo.rs](src/demo.rs): The three `playwright-rs` test functions described in the spec.

## Optional

- [Google Maps example on testingexamples.github.io](https://testingexamples.github.io/examples/google-maps/): The nine-language-and-tool comparison page this demo's Rust example matches.
- [playwright-rs on crates.io](https://crates.io/crates/playwright-rs): The Rust crate this demo depends on.
